Chapter 6560: A Hopeless Case

Chapter 6560: A Hopeless Case

“Excuse me then!” Primal Yin Immortal Ghost took the initiative and sent stars at the opponent at the greatest speed.

“Boom!” More than a hundred collided with Xian Chengtian in the center and instantly exploded.

The ghost grabbed a sun nearby, chanted an unknown mantra, and blew the flames toward Chengtian as well. Sunfire was frightening enough but this inferno was empowered by his mantra as well, leaving black holes behind in its wake.

Spectators couldn’t help but become impressed by the ghost cultivator’s decisiveness and deadly attacks. The overlord could pierce through Heaven World and kill numerous primal ancestors and heaven-slayers in one move.

However, the fiery stars couldn’t harm Xian Chengtian.

“This is it after breaking through?” Chengtian brushed the dust off his robe. There was just something about his immortal dao rhythm that made others feel inferior.

Although he never said it, the ghost could tell Chengtian had never viewed him in high regard.

“No hurry, we will see.” The ghost raised his hand and shot a golden light.

It attached onto Chengtian and erupted into flames, incinerating the stars nearby and forming black holes. Once the light reached its peak, the entire galaxy was not enough to serve as fuel. A suction force emerged, pulling in three thousand worlds beyond this galaxy.

“Rumble!” Heaven World was no exception and started to move closer.

“This is the end?!” Many shouted in horror during the quakes.

However, when the golden light reached its limit, it suddenly contracted and collapsed inward. Earlier, it tried to ignite Chengtian’s desires into an unstoppable storm. This would burn and destroy him from within.

However, Chengtian’s desires exceeded the ghost’s control. Thus, the golden light collapsed and was extinguished.

“Your vision is limited to that of an overlord, it cannot burn my desires, those of a true immortal.” Chengtian said.

The ghost’s expression soured. This luminous art was his pride but Chengtian looked down on it by saying it couldn’t endure his immortal desires.

This was akin to a poor man cursing a rich man. Alas, the insults and curses hurled couldn’t create steamed buns out of nowhere for him to eat. As for the rich man, he cared not for the steamed buns since he could feast on fine meats and delicacies instead. Therefore, the curses meant nothing to him, just the shouting of a clown.

“Just a newly rich pauper, unable to control the power that comes before immortality.” Chengtian stepped forward with a smile.

Whether they liked him or not, they had to admit he was incomparably perfect. His dao rhythm didn’t belong in the mortal world.

He lived among immortals, cherished with the greatest materials and treasures. This innate sense of superiority put many overlords to shame since they had to claw their way up from the depths.

“What are you so proud of? You can’t become an immortal under the guidance of three immortals, a true hopeless case.” The humiliated ghost barked back.

As the saying goes, hit someone but not their face. Chengtian might not care when someone brought up his unfilial past. However, the insult touched a sore spot - reducing his lifelong sense of superiority to a “hopeless case”.

“I’m hopeless?” Terrible rays emanated from his eyes, shooting across space.

Emperors and desolate gods who were foolish enough to venture out of Heaven World were cut into two halves by them.

He summoned a weapon - a simple stone hammer. The handle was made from a wood of unknown origin. The hammerhead was crafted from a rough, unnamed stone.

It was rough and irregular but golden rays oozed out from the cracks and pits, freezing time and space upon contact.
